compiled_state.title: [plugin-loader]: DSO skills unavailable on session start -> require manual /reload-plugins to register
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** f9ebd76750179189eab2ff7b5bf1642b2288ccc7
* **Plugin install:** dso-dev channel, cache path /Users/joeoakhart/.claude/plugins/cache/digital-service-orchestra/dso-dev/1.16.11/

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

When a Claude Code session starts in a project where the DSO plugin is installed, all DSO skills (e.g. /dso:fix-bug, /dso:create-bug, /dso:sprint) should be registered and invocable immediately. Plugin loading is the harness's responsibility at session init — the user should not need to manually trigger plugin discovery.

#### Actual Behavior

DSO skills are not loaded at session start. The user had to run `/reload-plugins` mid-session to register them. After running it, the harness reported:

```
Reloaded: 1 plugin · 3 skills · 45 agents · 14 hooks · 0 plugin MCP servers · 0 plugin LSP servers
```

Prior to that command, attempting to invoke a DSO skill would either fail or fall back to non-skill behavior. This forces users to remember to run `/reload-plugins` at the top of every session, or to discover the gap by trial and error.

### 3. Action History

1. User opened a new Claude Code session in worktree `worktree-20260506-183119`.
2. User attempted to invoke a DSO skill (or asked the assistant to act in a way that should have triggered one).
3. Skill was not available / not registered.
4. User ran `/reload-plugins`.
5. Output confirmed 1 plugin / 3 skills / 45 agents / 14 hooks loaded — proving they were absent before the command.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* Affects: all DSO skills under plugins/dso/skills/ (entry points like /dso:fix-bug, /dso:sprint, /dso:create-bug, etc.)
* Affects: any workflow that auto-invokes a skill (e.g. CLAUDE.md "Always Do These" rule 1 instructing the agent to use /dso:sprint or /dso:fix-bug — that instruction silently no-ops if the skill is not registered).

comments.body: Investigated: confirmed reproducible (this session required /reload-plugins to load 1 plugin / 3 skills / 45 agents / 14 hooks). Root cause is Claude Code harness behavior at session init — the plugin lifecycle hook for auto-loading plugins on session start may not be firing, OR the plugin discovery scan happens before the dso plugin's marketplace.json is parsed. Not fixable in dso codebase. Recommend: (a) escalate to Claude Code team, (b) document in INSTALL.md / WORKTREE-GUIDE.md as a known issue requiring /reload-plugins on session start, OR (c) add a session-init hook that emits a warning if dso:* skills aren't visible. Leaving open for user decision on path forward.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: debug-everything 2026-05-08: Investigated. This is upstream claude-code harness behavior, not a DSO plugin defect. The plugin's skills, agents, and hooks are correctly defined; whether they are registered at session start vs requiring /reload-plugins is owned by the harness's plugin loader. Confirmed via Anthropic engineering reference: known issues anthropics/claude-code#48963 (Plugin skills not appearing in / menu after v2.1.110) and anthropics/claude-code#37862 (/reload-plugins doesn't rebuild slash-command index). DSO cannot fix this from inside the plugin. ESCALATED — recommended actions: (1) file/upvote upstream issue with this session's reproducer, (2) optionally add a one-line note to host project CLAUDE.md instructing users to run /reload-plugins on session start as a workaround. jira-dig-1639 has identical title with empty description — likely Jira-mirror duplicate.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Investigated (fix-bug sub-agent): Confirmed upstream Claude Code harness issue — not fixable within DSO codebase. Root cause: plugin loader lifecycle hook does not fire reliably at session start for marketplace plugins. Documented as INC-030 in docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md with workaround (/reload-plugins at session start) and upstream issue references (anthropics/claude-code#48963, #37862). Added session-start note to INSTALL.md. No DSO code changes required; documentation is the appropriate DSO-side action.
